name: OOD Document Image Benchmark
description: The ability of a document classifier to handle inputs that are drawn from a distribution different from the training distribution is crucial for robust deployment and generalizability. The RVL-CDIP corpus is the de facto standard benchmark for document classification, yet to our knowledge all studies that use this corpus do not include evaluation on out-of-distribution documents. In this paper, we curate and release a new out-of-distribution benchmark for evaluating out-of-distribution performance for document classifiers. Our new out-of-distribution benchmark consists of two types of documents: those that are not part of any of the 16 in-domain RVL-CDIP categories (RVL-CDIP-O), and those that are one of the 16 in-domain categories yet are drawn from a distribution different from that of the original RVL-CDIP dataset (RVL-CDIP-N). reputation: A specialized academic benchmark that is well known within document AI research for probing out-of-distribution robustness beyond RVL-CDIP.
notes: Focused on OOD document classification rather than broad document understanding; relatively small and domain-specific, so results are not directly comparable to in-domain RVL-CDIP scores.
